subject: Energy
title: Potential Energy
description: A quick win: understand Potential Energy.

hook.text: A rock sitting on a cliff edge looks harmless—but it stores energy just by being high up.

buildup.text: Gravitational potential energy depends on mass, gravity, and height—lift something higher and it gains more.

discovery.text: When the rock falls, stored potential energy converts to kinetic energy—position becomes motion.

twist.text: A stretched rubber band stores elastic potential energy—springs, bows, and trampolines all work this way.

climax.text: Hydroelectric dams exploit gravitational potential—water falls from height, spinning turbines along the way.

punchline.text: Height is hidden energy—waiting for gravity to cash it in.

quiz.question: What type of energy does a stretched rubber band store?
